item.title: seeCph: Security
item.author: theisrud@gmail.com (Theis Rud Halkjær)
item.description: Adding security features like creating JWT to users when they login, packed with the token itself, id, name, email and the very important user roles that gives access to different endpoint depending on the specific role. Passwords are hashed and sertified using BCrypt, making it more secure.
